manual_items.title: Emergency access account operational governance
manual_items.description: Two cloud-only emergency access (break-glass) accounts must be maintained, excluded from Conditional Access policies, monitored with alerting and tested periodically.
manual_items.expected: Two cloud-only break-glass accounts verified with alerting and periodic testing
manual_items.message: Operational credential storage, physical vaulting, alerting rules and periodic break-glass testing records cannot be verified solely through Microsoft Graph.
manual_items.manual_reason: Operational credential storage, physical vaulting, alerting rules and periodic break-glass testing records cannot be verified solely through Microsoft Graph.

metadata.manual_guidance: Confirm two cloud-only Global Administrator emergency accounts exist, are excluded from Conditional Access policies, have sign-in alert rules configured in Sentinel or Azure Monitor, and have current test logs.

manual_items.title: Self-service password reset notifications and customisation
manual_items.description: Self-service password reset (SSPR) notifications, administrator alerts and registration customisation must align with the Blueprint baseline.
manual_items.expected: SSPR notifications and admin alerts verified in Microsoft Entra admin center
manual_items.message: Microsoft Entra self-service password reset portal notification and customisation settings have no full GA read-only Microsoft Graph API.
manual_items.manual_reason: Microsoft Entra self-service password reset portal notification and customisation settings have no full GA read-only Microsoft Graph API.

metadata.manual_guidance: Inspect Entra admin center -> Protection -> Password reset (Properties, Authentication methods, Registration and Notifications) and record evidence screenshots for the IRAP assessor.

results.title: Security defaults disabled in favour of Conditional Access
results.description: Security defaults must be disabled so that granular Blueprint Conditional Access policies can be enforced across the tenant.
results.message: isEnabled equals expected value false

results.title: Tenant country and data location set to Australia
results.description: The Microsoft Entra ID organisation country code must be set to AU (Australia) to align with Australian data residency requirements.
results.message: tenant countryLetterCode is AU

results.title: Non-admin users cannot register applications
results.description: Default user role permissions must prevent non-admin users from registering new applications in Entra ID.
results.message: defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToCreateApps equals expected value false

results.title: Non-admin users cannot create tenants
results.description: Default user role permissions must prevent non-admin users from creating unmanaged Entra tenants.
results.message: defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToCreateTenants equals expected value false

results.title: Non-admin users cannot create security groups
results.description: Default user role permissions must prevent non-admin users from creating Entra security groups.
results.message: defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToCreateSecurityGroups equals expected value false

results.title: Guest user access set to most restrictive
results.description: Guest user directory access must be restricted to properties and memberships of their own directory objects (2af84b1e-32c8-42b7-82bc-daa82404023b).
results.message: guestUserRoleId equals expected value 2af84b1e-32c8-42b7-82bc-daa82404023b

results.title: Guest invitations restricted to administrators and Guest Inviters
results.description: Only administrators and users assigned the Guest Inviter role (or nobody) may invite external guest users.
results.message: allowInvitesFrom (adminsAndGuestInviters) is in allowed set [none adminsAndGuestInviters]

results.title: Block legacy MSOL PowerShell for non-admins
results.description: Access to legacy MSOnline PowerShell endpoints must be blocked for non-administrator users.
results.message: blockMsolPowerShell equals expected value true

results.title: Restrict non-admin access to Microsoft Entra admin portal
results.description: Non-administrator users must be restricted from accessing the Microsoft Entra administration portal.
results.message: defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToReadOtherUsers equals expected value false

results.section: Entra ID / Enterprise applications / Consent and permissions
results.title: Do not allow user consent for applications
results.description: Users must not be allowed to consent to third-party applications accessing organisational data on their behalf.
results.message: defaultUserRolePermissions.permissionGrantPoliciesAssigned is empty (user consent disabled)

results.section: Entra ID / Enterprise applications / Consent and permissions
results.title: Admin consent workflow enabled
results.description: The Microsoft Entra admin consent request workflow must be enabled so application access requests are reviewed by designated reviewers.
results.message: isEnabled equals expected value true

results.title: Microsoft Entra Local Administrator Password Solution (LAPS) enabled
results.description: Microsoft Entra LAPS must be enabled to rotate and store local administrator credentials securely.
results.message: localAdminPassword.isEnabled equals expected value true

results.title: Microsoft Entra join permissions configured
results.description: Device registration policy must restrict Microsoft Entra join to an approved group or all managed users with Conditional Access enrolment enforcement and bounded device quota.
results.message: Entra join configured (#microsoft.graph.enumeratedDeviceRegistrationMembership) with userDeviceQuota=5

results.title: Device registration MFA delegated to Conditional Access
results.description: Legacy device registration MFA toggle should not conflict with strong authentication Conditional Access enrolment policies.
results.message: multiFactorAuthConfiguration (notRequired) is in allowed set [notRequired required]

results.section: Entra ID / External identities / Cross-tenant access
results.title: Cross-tenant default inbound B2B collaboration blocked
results.description: Default inbound B2B collaboration access in cross-tenant access settings must block unapproved external tenants by default.
results.message: default inbound B2B collaboration is blocked for users and applications

results.title: Users cannot create Microsoft 365 groups
results.description: The Group.Unified directory setting must set EnableGroupCreation to false so only authorised groups or administrators can create Microsoft 365 groups.
results.message: Group.Unified EnableGroupCreation is false

results.title: Phishing-resistant FIDO2 security keys enabled
results.description: FIDO2 security keys must be enabled in the authentication methods policy to support phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication.
results.message: FIDO2 security key authentication method is enabled

results.title: Weak legacy authentication methods (SMS, Voice, Email OTP) disabled
results.description: SMS, Voice and Email OTP authentication methods must be disabled in the authentication methods policy because they are not phishing-resistant.
results.message: SMS, Voice and Email OTP authentication methods are disabled

results.title: Temporary Access Pass enabled with bounded lifetime
results.description: Temporary Access Pass (TAP) should be enabled with a bounded lifetime (<= 480 minutes) for onboarding phishing-resistant credentials.
results.message: TemporaryAccessPass enabled with maximumLifetimeInMinutes=480

results.title: Entra Password Protection smart lockout and custom banned password list enabled
results.description: PasswordRuleSettings must enable the custom banned password list and configure smart lockout threshold <= 10 and lockout duration >= 60 seconds.
results.message: custom banned password list enabled, smart lockout threshold=10, duration=60s

results.title: System-preferred multi-factor authentication enabled
results.description: System-preferred MFA must be enabled so users are prompted with their strongest registered authentication method first.
results.message: systemCredentialPreferences.state equals expected value enabled

results.section: Entra ID / Conditional Access / Named locations
results.title: Approved countries named location includes Australia (AU)
results.description: At least one country named location must be configured including AU (Australia) for geo-fencing Conditional Access policies.
results.message: country named location "Approved Countries - Australia" includes AU and excludes unknown regions

results.title: Block legacy authentication
results.description: An enabled Conditional Access policy must target all users and all cloud applications and block exchangeActiveSync and other legacy client types.
results.actual: BP - Block access via legacy authentication
results.message: enabled policy "BP - Block access via legacy authentication" blocks legacy authentication

results.title: Require phishing-resistant or strong multi-factor authentication
results.description: An enabled Conditional Access policy must require MFA or a strong authentication strength for all users across all cloud applications.
results.message: enabled policy "BP - Require strong phishing-resistant authentication" requires strong authentication for all users

results.title: Require compliant devices
results.description: An enabled Conditional Access policy must require compliant devices (compliantDevice grant control) for access to organisational resources.
results.message: enabled policy "BP - Require compliant devices" enforces compliantDevice

results.title: Block high-risk users
results.description: An enabled Conditional Access policy must block sign-ins for users classified as high risk by Microsoft Entra ID Protection.
results.message: enabled policy "BP - Block high-risk users" blocks high-risk users

results.title: Block high-risk sign-ins
results.description: An enabled Conditional Access policy must block sign-ins classified as high risk by Microsoft Entra ID Protection.
results.message: enabled policy "BP - Block high-risk sign-ins" blocks high-risk sign-ins

results.title: Block access from unapproved countries
results.description: An enabled Conditional Access policy must block access from all locations except approved named locations.
results.message: enabled policy "BP - Block unapproved countries" blocks access outside approved named locations

results.title: Limit administrator session lifetime
results.description: An enabled Conditional Access policy targeting privileged directory roles must enforce a bounded sign-in frequency and non-persistent browser sessions.
results.message: enabled policy "BP - Limit administrator sessions" limits admin sessions (4 hours, persistentBrowser=never)

results.section: Entra ID / Identity governance / Privileged Identity Management
results.title: Permanent active Global Administrator assignments minimised
results.description: No more than two permanent (non-expiring) active Global Administrator assignments (reserved for break-glass accounts) should exist; operational administrators must use time-bound PIM eligible activations.
results.message: 2 permanent active Global Administrator assignment(s) found (maximum 2)
